reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience! The team offers top-notch service with a genuinely friendly and welcoming environment. What really stood out was their high level of technical expertise — every question was answered thoroughly, and every issue was resolved efficiently. On top of that, their availability and responsiveness are second to none. It’s rare to find a place that combines professionalism, warmth, and deep technical know-how so seamlessly. Highly recommended!
reviews.author: Jaime Gutierrez

reviews.text: WARNING:  DO NOT USE these guys.  They do work without quoting  and later you find yourself with huge bills that were not even discussed.  Pool cleaning is barely performed and when complained about, they say their guy was there as per "their" GPS.  They replaced a pool bulb after which the lens was found broken. They refused to take the responsibility!  BEWARE!
reviews.author: Tariq Usmani

reviews.text: Diamond Pools is great!!  We have recently purchased a house in N Fort Worth and were searching for a pool company.  I had several phone conversations with other companies, and left many messages  with no return call.  Diamond Pools answered the phone, Carlos was VERY professional, personable, treated me with respect,  answered tons of questions and put me at ease.  They came and serviced pool, checked equipment, and thoroughly cleaned pool and filters.  They did such a great job we have them come once a week!  Owning a pool is so uncomplicated with Diamond pools at the helm!!  PLUS the price for cleaning is lower than most.  Great company, we are happy!!!
reviews.author: j underc

reviews.text: I had an electrical problem with my pool filtration system and was hoping for timely assistance.  Carlos responded within 20 minutes.  He helped me diagnose the problem over the phone and via text.  I was able to fix the problem the same day and Carlos asked nothing in return.  The service was so good, the least I could do was send Diamond Pools a small check and write a great review!
reviews.author: Elio Mariani

reviews.text:
They charge 3 times as much as the part costs if you buy it yourself online, and after paying around $240 for them to simply change out my ignitor, the heater crapped out a couple days later.  To which they offered no compensation. I don't trust this company.

In response to owner's response:
The only reason 3 trips occurred is because the technician didn't listen when he was told not to arrive without my presence. He came anyways  (which the owner apologized for), and when he called to request entry into the backyard, he was immediately told to leave.
The technician was only here for about 45 minutes on the 2nd visit, and I was charged for double that in labor costs, so the owner is lying when he says I was only charged for 1 visit.  $280 is what they tried to charge me btw.
I wouldn't have bought the ignitor from these people had I known they were going to charge me so much. So be careful. Do your research. These people are in the business of making money, NOT helping you make the best decision!
The technician couldn't figure out what was wrong, so he said it was either the ignitor, or he was going to give an offer on a new heater. So again, the owner is being ridiculous when he tries to cast blame for my not requesting further diagnostics. Furthermore, why would I want more diagnostics from an overcharging company with a technician who doesn't follow instructions very well?
They installed a part that crapped out in about 3 days and offered no compensation. I asked for a refund of the unnecessary ignitor, to which I was ignored. Horrible company.

Oh also, the other company, A-Quality Pools, that came before them... the reason I was unhappy with them is because they were told to come over for a quote. I had already gotten a quote from one other company, and planned to get one more after A-Quality. Well? They came over and just fixed it without my permission. So much for shopping.
reviews.author: Alekzandr Apokalypto

reviews.text:
Carlos is a nice guy and his crew members were always nice and respectful, however, the workmanship of his crew is poor and the communication with customers is lacking.
The crew showed up at our house to begin our remodel without us even knowing they were coming.  They just showed up one Saturday to begin our remodel.
Carlos told us during the construction that his crews are not paid by the hour.  They are paid by the job and the day they were working on our pool, they still had another job to get done that same day.  This may partially explain why the workmanship is so poor, because the workers were rushed.
The tile around our pool is not level and there is a huge grout line above the tile that looks very bad.  We didn't realize what good workmanship our original pool builder had until we saw the work that Diamond Pools does.
Before we chose our plaster color, I asked Carlos if a dark plaster would mottle and he said no.  But sure enough the plaster did mottle and we had boot marks in the bottom of our pool from the workers walking on it before it was dry.  Carlos had his guys do a super strong acid wash in an attempt to correct the mottling.  Initiallly the mottling seemed to go away, but eventually it returned to it's original condition.  And the acid wash left part of the plaster etched and rough.
Carlos also assured us that the mortar in between the flagstone on our spa spillway would not wash out.  But less than a year after the remodel was complete, the mortar had washed out badly.  Carlos did honor the warranty, and after several communications from us, he had his crew come and replace the washed out mortar.
We cannot recommend Diamond Pools due to the unprofessional result we have with our pool tile and plaster.
reviews.author: Vonda Self

reviews.text:
Had these guys out to fix a pump.  They were great!
They were able to get to me within 24 hours AND had the part in stock.  New pumo was needed, but it was so powerful, the old fittings came loose.  He was so gracious to stay late and restore all of the fittings and my pool has not ran better!  I will use again!
reviews.author: Enjoying St Augustine
